jobs.title: Regional Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Lieu : Est de la Suisse romande — cantons de Vaud, Fribourg et Valais

Taux d’activité : Temps plein, 100%

Type de Contract : Contrat à durée indéterminée

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Chez Nestlé Professional , nous accompagnons les professionnels de la restauration avec des solutions café et culinaires de premier plan, permettant aux amateurs de gastronomie à travers toute la Suisse de profiter de produits de haute qualité grâce à des marques emblématiques telles que STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® et CHEF® .

En tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages , vous rejoignez une équipe expérimentée et engagée. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de comptes stratégiques sur l'Est de la Suisse romande, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, en élaborant des stratégies de croissance et en créant des partenariats durables avec vos clients.

Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous serez l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et contribuerez activement au développement de votre portefeuille en conciliant acquisition de nouveaux comptes, fidélisation des clients existants et atteinte durable des objectifs commerciaux.

Votre impact en tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Développer et entretenir des relations partenariales solides avec les clients, en agissant comme interlocuteur privilégié et en garantissant leur satisfaction à long terme.

• Identifier et concrétiser les opportunités d’acquisition de nouveaux clients, en élaborant des offres Food & Beverages adaptées à leurs besoins.

• Piloter les négociations contractuelles jusqu’à la conclusion des accords, en assurant l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux.

• Décliner et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de vente nationale au niveau régional, en l’adaptant au contexte local et aux spécificités des clients clés.

• Suivre, analyser et piloter la performance des clients à l’aide d’indicateurs clés, et définir des plans d’action structurés afin d’atteindre, voire dépasser, les objectifs fixés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes équipes internes.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Expérience réussie dans la vente au sein du secteur HORECA, idéalement dans les domaines du café, des boissons ou des produits culinaires.

• Excellent sens de la négociation et forte orientation résultats.

• Maîtrise du français et de l’allemand indispensable; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, flexibilité et forte orientation client.

Chez Nestlé Professional, les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous mettons tout en œuvre pour offrir un environnement de travail qui favorise votre développement professionnel, votre bien-être et votre équilibre de vie:

• Des modalités de travail flexibles adaptées aux exigences du poste.

• Des congés supérieurs aux dispositions légales.

• De nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement professionnel.

• Un système de rémunération variable lié à la performance.

• Une participation aux frais de santé ainsi qu'un programme d'assistance aux collaborateurs.

• Une contribution attractive à votre prévoyance professionnelle.

• Des congés parentaux généreux et des solutions de soutien aux familles.

• Des réductions avantageuses sur une large gamme de produits et services.

Vous évoluerez au sein d'un environnement inclusif et stimulant, offrant de nombreuses opportunités de développement et de collaboration à travers les différentes activités de Nestlé.

Comment se déroule notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier durant le processus, nous serons heureux de vous accompagner.

Le processus comprend généralement un entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition, un entretien avec le manager recruteur et les parties prenantes concernées, suivi d’une discussion finale et d’une proposition d’embauche. Les candidatures sont examinées au fil de leur réception ; nous vous encourageons donc à postuler rapidement.

Restez vigilant(e) : Nestlé ne contactera les candidats qu’à partir d’adresses e-mail officielles de l’entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiement ou d’informations bancaires dans le cadre du processus de recrutement.

jobs.title: Brand Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Brand Experience Specialist at Nestlé Suisse S.A., your mission is to rejuvenate THOMY and deepen consumer loyalty by delivering integrated brand experiences that strengthen emotional connection and drive sustainable growth. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, sales, communications, food-service teams, agencies and sponsorship partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Experience Specialist

• Turning consumer, cultural and category insights into compelling brand experiences that grow brand relevance and commercial impact.

• Shaping an omnichannel activation strategy that creates a seamless THOMY experience across the OOH / convenience channel.

• Activating an external network to build high-value local sponsorship partnerships that expand visibility, strengthen brand meaning and unlock sustainable growth.

• Developing and executing brand activations, live marketing events and brand experiences that convert participation into lasting loyalty, engagement and advocacy.

• Delivering integrated amplification plans that connect every activation to brand priorities and measurable business outcomes.

• Driving excellent execution through clear collaboration, smart resource allocation and continuous learning from results.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in brand marketing, consumer activation, communications, or shopper marketing, while acting as a passionate ambassador for THOMY both internally and externally.

• Applying Out-of-Home market knowledge to deliver integrated omnichannel activations that strengthen brand visibility and drive business results across the region, supported by the flexibility to travel regularly and a valid driver's license.

• Using consumer insights, performance metrics, and budget management expertise to optimize execution, measure effectiveness, and maximize return on investment.

• Collaborating effectively with agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams while leading projects from brief to successful implementation.

• Communicating fluently in Swiss German/German and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed, and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: La Tour-de-Peilz, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di Brand Experience Specialist presso Nestlé Suisse S.A., la vostra missione è di ringiovanire THOMY e approfondire la lealtà dei consumatori offrendo esperienze di brand integrate che rafforzano la connessione emotiva e spingono la crescita sostenibile. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con marketing, vendite, comunicazioni, team di food-service, agenzie e partner di sponsorizzazione. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di Brand Experience

• Trasformando intuizioni di consumatori, culturali e di categoria in esperienze di marca convincenti che crescono la rilevanza del marchio e l'impatto commerciale.

• Definire una strategia di attivazione omnicanale che crea un'esperienza di THOMY senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il canale OOH / convenienza.

• Attivare una rete esterna per costruire partnership di sponsorizzazione locali di alto valore che espandono la visibilità, rafforzino il significato del marchio e sbloccano la crescita sostenibile.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire le attivazioni del marchio, eventi di marketing dal vivo e le esperienze del marchio che convertono la partecipazione in una duratura fedeltà, impegno e advocacy.

• Fornire piani di amplificazione integrati che collegano ogni attivazione alle priorità del marchio e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Guidare l'esecuzione eccellente attraverso una collaborazione chiara, allocazione intelligente delle risorse e apprendimento continuo dai risultati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portando una forte esperienza nel marketing del marchio, nell'attivazione dei consumatori, nelle comunicazioni o nel marketing degli shopper, agendo come ambasciatore appassionato di THOMY sia internamente che esternamente.

• Applicando conoscenze di mercato Out-of-Home per fornire attivazioni omnichannel integrate che rafforzano la visibilità del marchio e i risultati aziendali di guida in tutta la regione, supportato dalla flessibilità di viaggiare regolarmente e dalla valida licenza del conducente.

• Utilizzando le conoscenze dei consumatori, le metriche delle prestazioni e le competenze di gestione del bilancio per ottimizzare l'esecuzione, misurare l'efficacia e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collaborare efficacemente con le agenzie, i partner esterni e i team interfunzionali, mentre i progetti principali da breve a successo implementazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco / tedesco svizzero e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronti a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

As a Brand Experience Specialist at Nestlé Suisse S.A., your mission is to rejuvenate THOMY and deepen consumer loyalty by delivering integrated brand experiences that strengthen emotional connection and drive sustainable growth. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, sales, communications, food-service teams, agencies and sponsorship partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Experience Specialist

• Turning consumer, cultural and category insights into compelling brand experiences that grow brand relevance and commercial impact.

• Shaping an omnichannel activation strategy that creates a seamless THOMY experience across the OOH / convenience channel.

• Activating an external network to build high-value local sponsorship partnerships that expand visibility, strengthen brand meaning and unlock sustainable growth.

• Developing and executing brand activations, live marketing events and brand experiences that convert participation into lasting loyalty, engagement and advocacy.

• Delivering integrated amplification plans that connect every activation to brand priorities and measurable business outcomes.

• Driving excellent execution through clear collaboration, smart resource allocation and continuous learning from results.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in brand marketing, consumer activation, communications, or shopper marketing, while acting as a passionate ambassador for THOMY both internally and externally.

• Applying Out-of-Home market knowledge to deliver integrated omnichannel activations that strengthen brand visibility and drive business results across the region, supported by the flexibility to travel regularly and a valid driver's license.

• Using consumer insights, performance metrics, and budget management expertise to optimize execution, measure effectiveness, and maximize return on investment.

• Collaborating effectively with agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams while leading projects from brief to successful implementation.

• Communicating fluently in Swiss German/German and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed, and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Als Brand Experience Specialist bei Nestlé Suisse S.A. ist es Ihre Mission, THOMY zu verjüngen und die Kundenbindung zu vertiefen, indem Sie integrierte Markenerlebnisse liefern, die die emotionale Verbindung stärken und nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben. Wie Sie als Brand Experience Specialist etwas bewirken

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und wachsen Sie durch Erfahrungen, die Sie weiter vorantreiben.

Être une force pour le bien et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin

En tant que spécialiste de l'expérience de la marque chez Nestlé Suisse S.A., votre mission est de rajeunir THOMY et d'approfondir la loyauté des consommateurs en offrant des expériences de marque intégrées qui renforcent la connexion émotionnelle et stimulent une croissance durable. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec le marketing, les ventes, les communications, les équipes de services alimentaires, les agences et les partenaires de parrainage. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de faire une différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de l'expérience de la marque

• Transformer les connaissances des consommateurs, des cultures et des catégories en expériences de marque convaincantes qui augmentent la pertinence de la marque et son impact commercial.

• Façonner une stratégie d'activation omnicanale qui crée une expérience THOMY transparente à travers le canal OOH / pratique.

• Activer un réseau externe pour créer des partenariats de parrainage locaux de grande valeur qui accroissent la visibilité, renforcent le sens de la marque et permettent une croissance durable.

• Développer et exécuter des activations de marque, des événements de marketing en direct et des expériences de marque qui transforment la participation en fidélité, engagement et plaidoyer durables.

• Fournir des plans d'amplification intégrés qui relient chaque activation aux priorités de marque et aux résultats opérationnels mesurables.

• Conduire une excellente exécution grâce à une collaboration claire, une allocation intelligente des ressources et un apprentissage continu des résultats.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans le marketing de marque, l'activation des consommateurs, les communications, ou le marketing d'achat, tout en agissant comme un ambassadeur passionné de THOMY à l'interne et à l'externe.

• Appliquer les connaissances du marché extérieur pour offrir des activations omnicanales intégrées qui renforcent la visibilité de la marque et stimulent les résultats commerciaux dans toute la région, soutenues par la flexibilité de voyager régulièrement et un permis de conduire valide.

• Utiliser les connaissances des consommateurs, les mesures du rendement et l'expertise en gestion budgétaire pour optimiser l'exécution, mesurer l'efficacité et maximiser le rendement des investissements.

• Collaborer efficacement avec les organismes, les partenaires externes et les équipes interfonctionnelles tout en menant des projets de courte durée à une mise en oeuvre réussie.

• Communiquer couramment en allemand/allemand et en anglais.

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus d'embauche interne équitable et transparent et nous veillons à ce que toutes les demandes soient traitées de façon confidentielle.

Votre demande comprendra généralement un examen initial, des conversations avec Talent Acquisition et l'équipe d'embauche, suivies d'une discussion finale.

Appliquer maintenant et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin.

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

Als Coffee Specialist bei Nespresso begeistern Sie unsere Kund:innen mit Ihrer Leidenschaft für Service und Kaffee. Als erste Ansprechperson in der Boutique erkennen Sie ihre Bedürfnisse und schaffen durch persönliche Beratung ein erstklassiges Markenerlebnis. • Sicherstellen eines herzlichen Empfangs und eines angenehmen Erlebnisses für unsere Gäste sowie individuelle Beratung unserer Kundschaft, Durchführung von Kaffeedegustationen und aktiver Verkauf unserer Produkte

• Eigenständige Behebung einfacher Maschinenstörungen sowie Koordination von Reparaturen

• Unterstützung und Beratung des Teams bei technischen Fragestellungen rund um unsere Kaffeemaschinen

• Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung von Ersatzteilen sowie der Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanliegen in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Servicepartnern

• Erfassung von Bestellungen, Durchführung der Kassenabrechnung sowie sorgfältige Pflege und laufende Aktualisierung der Kundendatei

• Aktiver Beitrag zur Erreichung individueller sowie Boutique-Ziele und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Kundenerlebnisses in der Boutique

Was Sie erfolgreich macht

• Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Retail oder in der Gastronomie

• Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Leidenschaft für Kaffee, Marke und einzigartige Kundenerlebnisse

• Interesse und Freude daran, technische Fragestellungen rund um Kaffeemaschinen zu lösen sowie Ihr Wissen mit Kolleg:innen zu teilen

• Erfahrung in der Schulung, Unterstützung oder fachlichen Begleitung von Kolleg:innen ist von Vorteil

• Flexible, gut organisierte und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen wie Englisch sind ein Plus

Was Sie bei Nespresso erwartet

Wir wachsen gemeinsam – in einer Kultur der Wertschätzung, Inklusion und Innovation. Unsere Benefits unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung und Ihr Wohlbefinden:

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf eine Vielzahl von Produkten und Dienstleistungen des täglichen Bedarf

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über den gesetzlichen Anspruch hinaus

• Grosszügiger Elternurlaub sowie umfassende Unterstützungsangebote für Familien

• Beitrag zur Gesundheitsversorgung und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktiver Arbeitgeberbeitrag zur Pensionskasse

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Förderung Ihrer beruflichen Weiterentwicklung

Was Sie in unserem Bewerbungsprozess erwartet

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Bewerbungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützung zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig barrierefrei und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Einrichtungen und Prozessen, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Fachbereich sowie ein abschließendes Gespräch mit Angebot. Wir prüfen eingehende Bewerbungen fortlaufend und schließen die Stelle, sobald wir eine überzeugende Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen identifiziert haben – daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie aufmerksam: Nestlé nimmt mit Bewerber:innen ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens Kontakt auf und wird Sie zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Bewerbungsprozess um Zahlungen oder die Angabe sensibler persönlicher Informationen bitten.

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie neu, was Sie werden können.

In welcher Funktion auch immer – Sie können echte Veränderungen bewirken und andere für Ihre Ideen begeistern. Bei Nespresso werden Sie aufblühen und sich zugehörig fühlen. Wir inspirieren Sie, sich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und Ihr Bestes zu geben.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Patent Counsel – Nutrition & Health at Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., your mission is to enable and protect science-driven innovation in Medical Nutrition through pragmatic legal services and business-focused intellectual property protection. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, project leaders, Research and Development management, business stakeholders and Legal colleagues across Vevey, Konolfingen and global Research and Development locations. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Nutrition & Health

• Partnering with Medical Nutrition teams to identify, protect and leverage innovations that improve outcomes for patients and consumers.

• Developing intellectual property strategies that support category priorities, business objectives and long-term innovation leadership.

• Building robust protection plans for strategic projects across the full innovation lifecycle.

• Managing patent drafting, filing and prosecution activities worldwide to create value and protect Nestlé’s competitive advantage.

• Delivering patentability, freedom-to-operate and competitor intelligence insights that help teams make confident innovation decisions.

• Contributing to partnerships, licensing, due diligence, oppositions and litigation matters where intellectual property expertise is critical.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong patent expertise and the ability to create practical protection strategies for science-driven innovation.

• Applying advanced scientific knowledge in fields such as food science, nutrition, biochemistry, biotechnology, life sciences, chemistry, pharmaceuticals or health sciences.

• Using strategic judgement to manage patent portfolios across multiple jurisdictions with a focus on value creation, risk management and cost efficiency.

• Collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams, external patent firms and senior stakeholders in an international environment.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value. We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Associate Robotics Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based, full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As an Associate Robotics Specialist at the Nestlé Deep Tech Center , your mission is to help identify, evaluate, develop and deploy advanced robotics and intelligent automation solutions that turn emerging technologies into scalable manufacturing solutions. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project teams, research and development centers, engineering hubs, factories, pilot plants, quality labs, suppliers, system integrators, universities and technology partners. This is your opportunity to accelerate Nestlé’s innovation mission and deliver meaningful results that shape the future of food at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Robotics Specialist

• Building and applying robotics expertise to unlock smarter, safer and more efficient manufacturing solutions.

• Scouting and evaluating emerging technologies that can become practical, scalable automation concepts.

• Supporting robotics projects from early opportunity framing through proof of concept, pilot and industrial deployment.

• Delivering work packages across requirements, design reviews, commissioning, start-up and qualification with a focus on quality, safety and reliability.

• Translating validated concepts into maintainable automation solutions that can be reused across different use cases and environments.

• Sharing knowledge, documentation and training content that strengthens adoption and builds robotics capability across our community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing hands-on knowledge of robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial artificial intelligence or advanced engineering projects.

• Applying practical exposure to robotics integration, end-of-arm manipulation, mobile robotics, machine vision, sensors or robot safety.

• Using programming, data analysis, simulation or digital twin tools to support robust technical recommendations and solutions.

• Collaborating across technical and operational teams with proactivity, autonomy, comfort with ambiguity and a strong focus on safety and quality.

• Communicating confidently in English and presenting technical ideas clearly to diverse audiences; French is a plus.

• Thriving in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment and being ready to move fast from concept to reality, while translating ideas into measurable impact

At Nestlé Deep Tech Center, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

Nestlé is an inclusive employer and, if needed, we are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout your journey with us. All information is treated confidentially.

Our workplace is fully barrier free with step free access, elevators to all floors, and accessible restrooms. We also maintain a strong safety culture, supported by modern installations and procedures to ensure a secure environment for everyone.

Our hiring process typically includes application review, a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications on a rolling basis and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

You will make a difference by collaborating closely with project teams, research and development centers, engineering hubs, factories, pilot plants, quality labs, suppliers, system integrators, universities and technology partners. This is your opportunity to accelerate Nestlé’s innovation mission and deliver meaningful results that shape the future of food at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Robotics Specialist

• Building and applying robotics expertise to unlock smarter, safer and more efficient manufacturing solutions.

• Scouting and evaluating emerging technologies that can become practical, scalable automation concepts.

• Supporting robotics projects from early opportunity framing through proof of concept, pilot and industrial deployment.

• Delivering work packages across requirements, design reviews, commissioning, start-up and qualification with a focus on quality, safety and reliability.

• Translating validated concepts into maintainable automation solutions that can be reused across different use cases and environments.

• Sharing knowledge, documentation and training content that strengthens adoption and builds robotics capability across our community.

What will make you successful

• Bringing hands-on knowledge of robotics, automation, mechatronics, industrial artificial intelligence or advanced engineering projects.

• Applying practical exposure to robotics integration, end-of-arm manipulation, mobile robotics, machine vision, sensors or robot safety.

• Using programming, data analysis, simulation or digital twin tools to support robust technical recommendations and solutions.

• Collaborating across technical and operational teams with proactivity, autonomy, comfort with ambiguity and a strong focus on safety and quality.

• Thriving in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment and being ready to move fast from concept to reality, while translating ideas into measurable impact

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

jobs.title: Digital Process Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Digital Process Design Engineer at Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, your mission is to develop, standardize and govern process engineering drawings and digital plant models that enable safe, efficient and reusable solutions for nutrition industrialization projects. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with process and automation engineers, project managers, factory teams and equipment suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Process Design Engineer

• Developing accurate process diagrams, equipment layouts and three-dimensional plant models that turn engineering concepts into implementation-ready designs.

• Standardizing modular design components, drawing libraries and templates to improve quality, consistency and reuse across global projects.

• Reviewing supplier drawings and digital models to identify clashes and strengthen safety, hygiene, operability, maintainability and accessibility.

• Delivering basic engineering solutions for defined process units, including layouts, equipment interfaces, utility needs and technical specifications.

• Managing engineering data and synchronized digital plant information so teams can find, trust and use current documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Driving continuous improvement in design workflows and standards while sharing practical drafting knowledge with engineers, factories and suppliers.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong two-dimensional and three-dimensional drafting capability for process plants, equipment layouts and engineering documentation.

• Applying computer-aided design tools, ideally including AutoCAD, Plant 3D and Inventor, to create precise and reusable design solutions.

• Using knowledge of process equipment, piping, utilities, instrumentation and hygienic design to strengthen safe and practical layouts.

• Collaborating proactively with engineers, factory partners and suppliers while managing engineering data, revisions and document standards with care.

• Communicating confidently in English at a good working level.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist Lipids
jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist Lipids at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen scientific expertise and generate new insights in lipid physics and chemistry for food applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with multidisciplinary research teams, product development teams, expert networks, innovation partners, suppliers, universities, and research institutes. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Lipids

• Building scientific knowledge of emerging methods, trends, and discoveries in lipid science and technology.

• Developing robust scientific concepts that translate lipid research into food applications and consumer benefits.

• Leading research projects and communicating scientific approaches and results to technical and business audiences.

• Designing and executing laboratory studies that advance understanding of lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Transferring scientific knowledge to development teams to accelerate innovation projects and successful product launches.

• Strengthening scientific visibility through intellectual property, publications, conference presentations, and coaching of students and technicians.

What will make you successful

• Holding a PhD in Food Science/Chemistry, Food Engineering, or a related area, with strong knowledge of lipid science, including lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Applying analytical thinking and problem-solving to turn science and technology into consumer and business value.

• Using project management, organisation, and communication skills to deliver clear scientific outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across disciplines while showing initiative, integrity, and a passion for knowledge sharing.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

jobs.description:
Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

jobs.description:
Division « Eau » du groupe Nestlé, Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA est le leader suisse du marché des eaux minérales avec des marques telles que Henniez, S. Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier et Acqua Panna, ainsi que d’autres grandes marques de boissons sans alcool. Nestlé Waters Suisse forme une vingtaine d’apprentis par année.

Apprentissage de technologue du brassage et des boissons

(Technologue en denrées alimentaires)

août 2026 – juillet 2029

Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA, Henniez

Résumé de la position

• Nous offrons un environnement d’apprentissage stimulant et varié pour obtenir ton CFC et une bonne formation pour ton avenir

• L’apprentissage se fait dans notre toute nouvelle siroperie, sur la ligne de production ainsi que dans notre laboratoire

• Très bon encadrement par des formateurs qualifiés

• Différents avantages : chèques REKA, demi-tarif train offert, rabais fitness, bons Henniez, rabais Nestlé Shop, cours à l’interne (informatique, gestion du stress, postulation)

• Six semaines de vacances

• Salaires attractifs

Un jour dans la vie d’un/e apprentie/e technologuedu brassage et des boissons

• Préparation des sirops et des recettes des différentes boissons (jus de fruits)

• Réception des matières premières

• Contrôles réguliers des machines et des produits durant le processus de production

• Respect de toutes les mesures de sécurité et des bonnes pratiques de fabrication

• Réalisation de la maintenance courante des installations

• Prise d’échantillons pour diverses analyses chimiques et microbiologiques

• Contrôle de qualité

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Fin de scolarité obligatoire avec de bons résultats en maths

• Sens technique et goût pour les chiffres

• Habilité manuelle

• Être prêt/e à travailler en horaire d’équipe plus tard

• Capable de supporter des conditions de travail avec du bruit et de la chaleur

• Poste ouvert également pour des reconversions pour professionnels ayant travaillé dans l’industrie alimentaire (boulanger, technologue du lait, pâtissier)

• Langue maternelle française

Tu cherches un apprentissage varié avec une bonne ambiance de travail ? N’hésite pas à postuler! (lettre de motivation, CV et bulletin de notes des deux dernières années)

jobs.title: Planificateur·trice maintenance & Superuser AMM
jobs.description:
Lieu : Orbe, Suisse
Modèle de travail : Sur site / Temps plein
Type de contrat / durée : CDI
Date d’entrée : à déterminer

Résumé du poste

En tant que Planificateur·trice de maintenance & Superuser AMM (Asset Maintenance Management) chez Nestlé, ta mission est de renforcer la fiabilité de nos lignes de production café en planifiant, coordonnant et améliorant les activités de maintenance. Tu feras la différence en collaborant étroitement avec la production, les technicien·ne·s de maintenance, le magasin technique, l’ingénierie, la qualité et nos partenaires externes. Ce rôle clé te permettra de connecter avec des spécialistes, de développer ton expertise et de créer un impact pour la fabrique et à l’échelle du site.

Ton impact en tant que Planificateur·trice de maintenance & Superuser AMM

• Planifier les activités de maintenance production café pour maximiser la disponibilité des lignes, réduire les arrêts non planifiés et améliorer la maîtrise des coûts.

• Coordonner et suivre les interventions avec les équipes de production, de maintenance et les partenaires externes afin de garantir une exécution fluide, sûre et efficace.

• Analyser en détail les indicateurs de maintenance, les pannes et les coûts afin d’apporter des explications claires, d’anticiper les écarts et de prioriser les actions clés.

• Mettre en place et animer les routines de suivi hebdomadaires et mensuelles afin de suivre les activités réalisées, les coûts et la maintenance planifiée.

• Améliorer les plans de maintenance et la qualité des données afin de renforcer la fiabilité des équipements et la performance opérationnelle.

• Gérer les changements de manière agile, en ajustant les priorités lorsque nécessaire et en maintenant une exécution efficace des activités de maintenance.

• Optimiser la gestion des pièces de rechange et des consommables avec le magasin technique pour améliorer les délais d’intervention et la fiabilité des équipements.

• Transmettre tes connaissances et coacher les équipes sur les outils de planification afin de soutenir des pratiques harmonisées et fiables.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les autres planificateur·trice·s du site afin d’identifier des synergies, d’harmoniser les pratiques et de renforcer l’efficacité collective.

• Renforcer la sécurité, la qualité, le 5S et la conformité au quotidien, en identifiant les risques et en proposant des améliorations concrètes.

Ce qui fera ta réussite dans le rôle

• Apporter une solide expertise en planification de maintenance industrielle et une bonne compréhension des environnements de production.

• Déployer des méthodes structurées de planification, de suivi budgétaire et de résolution de problèmes pour renforcer la performance, accompagner le changement et assurer un suivi proactif des indicateurs.

• Utiliser SAP PM, PowerBI, les outils digitaux et les indicateurs de performance pour piloter les activités avec des données fiables et exploitables.

• Contribuer à l’évolution des méthodes de planification, y compris par la création ou l’amélioration d’outils numériques lorsque cela apporte de la valeur.

• Faire preuve de curiosité pour intégrer l’IA dans tes activités et proposer de nouvelles façons de gagner en efficacité, en qualité et en impact.

• Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, en restant proche du terrain et en mobilisant les équipes autour d’améliorations concrètes des pratiques de maintenance.

• Communiquer couramment en français et en anglais.

• Faire preuve de courage, de collaboration, de réactivité et de curiosité.

Chez NCH, nous plaçons les personnes au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous offrons un ensemble d’avantages compétitif et complet, conçu pour soutenir ta croissance et ton bien-être au travail comme dans ta vie personnelle :

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Participation aux frais de santé et programme d’aide aux employés pour toi et ta famille

• Forte contribution de l’employeur à ton plan de prévoyance

• Congé parental généreux et solutions complètes de soutien à la famille

• Opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement pour faire grandir tes compétences

• Remises attractives pour les employés sur des produits et services du quotidien

Ce à quoi t’attendre dans notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse, et nous sommes disponibles pour mettre en place des aménagements raisonnables si nécessaire. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une forte culture sécurité, avec des installations modernes et des procédures visant à garantir un environnement sûr pour toutes et tous.

Le processus de recrutement comprend généralement un premier échange avec la recruteuse, un entretien avec le responsable Maintenance incluant une étude de cas, puis une discussion finale avec le responsable Ingénierie avant une éventuelle offre. Nous examinons les candidatures au fur et à mesure et nous clôturons le poste dès qu’une liste solide de candidat·e·s pertinent·e·s est identifiée ; nous t’encourageons donc à postuler dès que possible. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Prêt·e à contribuer à la performance de notre fabrique ? Postule maintenant.

Ce qui fera ta réussite dans le rôle

• Apporter une solide expertise en planification de maintenance industrielle et une bonne compréhension des environnements de production.

• Déployer des méthodes structurées de planification, de suivi budgétaire et de résolution de problèmes pour renforcer la performance, accompagner le changement et assurer un suivi proactif des indicateurs.

• Utiliser SAP PM, PowerBI, les outils digitaux et les indicateurs de performance pour piloter les activités avec des données fiables et exploitables.

• Contribuer à l’évolution des méthodes de planification, y compris par la création ou l’amélioration d’outils numériques lorsque cela apporte de la valeur.

• Faire preuve de curiosité pour intégrer l’IA dans tes activités et proposer de nouvelles façons de gagner en efficacité, en qualité et en impact.

• Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, en restant proche du terrain et en mobilisant les équipes autour d’améliorations concrètes des pratiques de maintenance.

• Communiquer couramment en français et en anglais.

• Faire preuve de courage, de collaboration, de réactivité et de curiosité.

Chez NCH, nous plaçons les personnes au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous offrons un ensemble d’avantages compétitif et complet, conçu pour soutenir ta croissance et ton bien-être au travail comme dans ta vie personnelle :

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Participation aux frais de santé et programme d’aide aux employés pour toi et ta famille

• Forte contribution de l’employeur à ton plan de prévoyance

• Congé parental généreux et solutions complètes de soutien à la famille

• Opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement pour faire grandir tes compétences

• Remises attractives pour les employés sur des produits et services du quotidien

Ce à quoi t’attendre dans notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse, et nous sommes disponibles pour mettre en place des aménagements raisonnables si nécessaire. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une forte culture sécurité, avec des installations modernes et des procédures visant à garantir un environnement sûr pour toutes et tous.

Le processus de recrutement comprend généralement un premier échange avec la recruteuse, un entretien avec le responsable Maintenance incluant une étude de cas, puis une discussion finale avec le responsable Ingénierie avant une éventuelle offre. Nous examinons les candidatures au fur et à mesure et nous clôturons le poste dès qu’une liste solide de candidat·e·s pertinent·e·s est identifiée ; nous t’encourageons donc à postuler dès que possible. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Prêt·e à contribuer à la performance de notre fabrique ? Postule maintenant.

jobs.title: Communications Manager - Content & Editorial
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland

Entity : Nestlé SA
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: ASAP

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Communications Manager – Content & Editorial at Nestlé, your mission is to help shape and elevate corporate storytelling by driving editorial excellence and content strategy across internal and external channels. You’ll make a difference by bringing a proactive approach and collaborating closely with Corporate Affairs teams, Content Studios, markets, functions, and subject-matter experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Communications Manager – Content & Editorial

• Driving a forward-looking content strategy and editorial planning that brings business priorities, purpose, and reputation topics to life.

• Building compelling storylines and narratives across articles, scripts, long-form storytelling, and social content to strengthen trust and engagement.

• Delivering end-to-end content development, actively drafting and refining content, while also briefing, guiding, and reviewing work with internal teams, studios, and agencies.

• Overseeing the planning and creation of content assets, including articles, scripts, videos, social assets and long-form storytelling.

• Empowering a high-performing Content & Editorial team through clear priorities, coaching, and consistent feedback.

• Improving content impact by using performance insights and feedback to continuously evolve formats, language, and storytelling approaches.

What will make you successful

• Bringing proven experience in corporate communications, journalism, or editorial/content leadership to deliver inspiring, high-quality content and campaigns that strengthen trust and reputation.

• Applying excellent writing and editing skills to translate complex topics into crisp language, while safeguarding tone of voice and reputational risk.

• Shaping content strategy and storytelling, using audience needs and performance insights to improve impact.

• Ideating and delivering end-to-end multimedia content.

• As a people-focused team leader, developing and coaching others while partnering confidently in a fast-paced matrix environment.

• Communicating with full professional proficiency in English (expert proficiency in written English).

• Championing continuous improvement, innovation and new storytelling, including effective use of emerging tools and technologies.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and final interviews and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

jobs.title: Anlagenführer/-in Special Products
jobs.description:
Übersicht Position

Standort: Konolfingen, Schweiz
Unternehmen: Nestlé Schweiz S.A. Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%
Vertragsart: unbefristet
Anstellungsbeginn: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Benefits

• Internationales Arbeitsumfeld

• Durchschnittlich 41-Stunden-Woche, je nach Schichtplan

• Min. 25 Tage Ferien pro Jahr, je nach Alter mehr

• 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub, 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• 13. Monatslohn und Bonusmöglichkeit

• Leistungen der Pensionskasse über dem gesetzlichen Minimum

• Beiträge an die Krankentaggeldversicherung zu 100% vom Arbeitgeber bezahlt

• Schichtpauschale sowie Schichtzulagen über den gesetzlichen Vorgaben

• Kostenfreies Schichtessen

• Kostenfreier Parkplatz

• Rabatt im Nestlé Shop (vor Ort in Konolfingen)

• Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio in Konolfingen zu Sonderkonditionen

• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Karriereentwicklung und persönlichen Entfaltung

Kurzüberblick Position

550 Mitarbeitende, die für die Herstellung hochwertiger Säuglingsnahrung für das In- und Ausland zuständig sind, prägen das dynamische, hochautomatisierte Arbeitsumfeld der Fabrik Konolfingen. Dies stellt täglich hohe Ansprüche an unser Team in Bezug auf Einhaltung von Hygienebestimmungen und Arbeitssicherheit. Möchten auch Sie Teil unseres Teams sein?

Zur Verstärkung unserer Abteilung Special Products (SP) suchen wir eine kommunikative und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Anlagenführer/-in.

Ein Tag im Leben eines/-r Anlagenführer/-in

• Aufbereitung von Milch und Kindernahrungsmitteln mit Hilfe moderner Produktionsanlagen

• Durchführung der Rohstoffaufgabe, Sprühtrocknung sowie Mischen, Bereitstellung und Abfüllung von Pulver

• Durchführung des Reinigungsprozesses (CIP-Reinigungen) sowie allgemeine Reinigungsarbeiten gemäss den bestehenden Qualitätsvorgaben

• Dokumentation der Produktions- und Reinigungsabläufe

• Tätigkeiten im Linienlabor und Durchführung von Analysen gemäss QMS

• Verantwortlichkeit für die Produktherstellung unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Hygiene- und Umweltvorschriften sowie nach NGMP und SOP's

• Sicherstellung eines schonenden Umganges mit Roh- und Packstoffen sowie Energien, Anlagen, Laborgeräten und Reinigungsmitteln

• Bereitschaft zur Schicht- und Wochenendarbeit

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene EFZ-Ausbildung als Milchtechnologe oder Lebensmitteltechnologe oder langjährige Erfahrung als Anlagenführer/-in im Lebensmittelbereich

• Gutes technisches Verständnis und ein proaktives Handeln

• Kundenorientiertes Verhalten in allen Arbeitssituationen

• Ausgeprägtes Sicherheits-, Umwelt- und Hygienebewusstsein

• Teamfähige und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die Eigeninitiative und Engagement zeigt

• Geübter Umgang in SAP, MES und MS Office

• Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse (min. Niveau B2)

Wir bei Nestlé wollen dazu beitragen, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und in einem Umfang und Tempo zu arbeiten, das einen Unterschied machte. Wir tun dies, indem wir ein vielfältiges, freundliches, unterstützendes und kollaboratives Umfeld fördern, das positiven Wandel hervorruft, Innovationen begrüsst und Menschen und Teams befähigt, zu gewinnen.

Sie möchten für die ganz Kleinen auf dieser Welt Grosses bewirken? Werden Sie Teil von Nestlé und senden uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome etc.) direkt online zu.

jobs.title: Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne , Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist at Société des Produits Nestlé SA, your mission is to turn nutrition data into reliable insights, digital prototypes and reporting capabilities that support Nestlé’s Nutrition, Health and Wellness (NHW) strategy and strengthen the nutritional value of our product portfolio. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with the NHW, Research and Development, IT teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist

• Leading nutrition data analysis to support portfolio decisions.

• Building automated dashboards and reporting capabilities that improve accuracy, efficiency and visibility across global nutrition data.

• Driving data quality, validation and audit readiness to strengthen confidence in internal and external nutrition reporting.

• Developing digital prototypes and new automated functionalities that make nutrition reporting and benchmarking faster, smarter and easier to use.

• Delivering data-driven knowledge projects with clear plans, strong governance and high-quality scientific outputs.

• Nurturing cross-functional networks to understand business needs, share ideas and build digital nutrition capabilities at scale.

What will make you successful

• Master's degree in a relevant field such as data science, statistics, nutrition, food science or equivalent.

• Bringing strong data analytics skills, ideally applied to nutrition, food data or scientific reporting.

• Proven previous experience, preferably in a food manufacturing or recipe management environment.

• Applying knowledge of recipe management, food regulations, nutrition labelling and data governance to create reliable outputs.

• Using data analysis, visualisation, database querying or programming tools to translate complex data into clear insights.

• Collaborating across functions, influencing with integrity and managing projects to deliver meaningful outcomes.

• Communicating with working proficiency in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

jobs.title: Associate Specialist in Lipids
jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate R&D Specialist in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide scientific expertise in advanced lipid analytics to help developing, validating and transferring fit-for-purpose analytical methodologies to support product innovation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an associate R&D specialist in Lipids Analytics

• Leading project activities with independence, accuracy, and scientific rigor to meet defined objectives and timelines.

• Organizing laboratories activities and carrying out experiments involving internal or external partners.

• Driving the implementation of analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities in our Nestlé Operation sites across the world.

• Strengthening the scientific evidence on lipids to support breakthrough innovation.

• Contributing to technological scouting and drive continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD with recognized expertise in lipid analysis using advanced-analytics based on mass spectrometry techniques (HRMS and MS/MS) with 1-3 years of expertise in the domain.

• Leveraging operational and business needs and research thinking to develop, validate and transfer fit-for-purpose analytical methods to support product innovation.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity, agility and creativity across research and technology.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer.

We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Specialista R&D associato nel dipartimento Lipids & Metabolic Analytics presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire competenze scientifiche nell'analisi dei lipidi avanzata per aiutare a sviluppare, convalidare e trasferire metodologie analitiche adeguate per supportare l'innovazione del prodotto. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti, partner di innovazione e team tecnici in Nestlé. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come specialista R&D associato a Lipids Analytics

• Le principali attività di progetto con indipendenza, accuratezza e rigore scientifico per soddisfare obiettivi e tempi definiti.

• Organizzazione delle attività dei laboratori e realizzazione di esperimenti che coinvolgono partner interni o esterni.

• Guidare l'implementazione di metodi analitici e soluzioni tecniche che migliorano le capacità di analisi dei lipidi nei nostri siti di Nestlé Operation in tutto il mondo.

• Rafforzare le prove scientifiche sui lipidi per sostenere l'innovazione innovativa.

• Contribuire allo scouting tecnologico e a migliorare continuamente.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un dottorato con competenze riconosciute nell'analisi dei lipidi utilizzando analisi avanzate basate sulle tecniche di spettrometria di massa (HRMS e MS/MS) con 1-3 anni di esperienza nel dominio.

• Sfruttando le esigenze operative e aziendali e il pensiero di ricerca per sviluppare, convalidare e trasferire metodi analitici idonei a sostenere l'innovazione dei prodotti.

• Collaborare con una qualità focalizzata, proattiva e curiosità, agilità e creatività attraverso la ricerca e la tecnologia.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta.

Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate R&D Specialist in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide scientific expertise in advanced lipid analytics to help developing, validating and transferring fit-for-purpose analytical methodologies to support product innovation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an associate R&D specialist in Lipids Analytics

• Leading project activities with independence, accuracy, and scientific rigor to meet defined objectives and timelines.

• Organizing laboratories activities and carrying out experiments involving internal or external partners.

• Driving the implementation of analytical methods and technical solutions that improve lipid analysis capabilities in our Nestlé Operation sites across the world.

• Strengthening the scientific evidence on lipids to support breakthrough innovation.

• Contributing to technological scouting and drive continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD with recognized expertise in lipid analysis using advanced-analytics based on mass spectrometry techniques (HRMS and MS/MS) with 1-3 years of expertise in the domain.

• Leveraging operational and business needs and research thinking to develop, validate and transfer fit-for-purpose analytical methods to support product innovation.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity, agility and creativity across research and technology.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer.

We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Associate R&D Specialist in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics Abteilung bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, wissenschaftliche Expertise in fortschrittlicher Lipidanalyse bereitzustellen, um die Entwicklung, Validierung und Übertragung von geeigneten analytischen Methoden zur Unterstützung der Produktinnovation zu unterstützen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Experten, Innovationspartnern und technischen Teams in Nestlé zusammenarbeiten. Wie Sie als assoziierter F & E-Spezialist in Lipids Analytics etwas bewirken können

• Projektaktivitäten mit Unabhängigkeit, Genauigkeit und wissenschaftlicher Strenge, um definierte Ziele und Zeitpläne zu erfüllen.

• Organisation von Laboraktivitäten und Durchführung von Experimenten mit internen oder externen Partnern.

• Förderung der Implementierung von Analysemethoden und technischen Lösungen, die die Fähigkeiten der Lipidanalyse in unseren Nestlé-Standorten auf der ganzen Welt verbessern.

• Stärkung der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse über Lipide zur Unterstützung bahnbrechender Innovationen.

• Beitrag zum technologischen Scouting und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen Doktortitel mit anerkannter Expertise in der Lipidanalyse mit fortschrittlicher Analyse auf Basis von Massenspektrometrie-Techniken (HRMS und MS / MS) mit 1-3 Jahren Erfahrung in diesem Bereich.

• Nutzung der betrieblichen und geschäftlichen Anforderungen und des Forschungsdenkens zur Entwicklung, Validierung und Übertragung von geeigneten Analysemethoden zur Unterstützung der Produktinnovation.

• Zusammenarbeit mit einer qualitätsorientierten, proaktiven und neugierigen, Agilität und Kreativität in Forschung und Technologie.

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot.

Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bereit für #BreakthroughTogether?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.
